## Summary

**MOVS** (Move with Sign extend).

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `<ea> → Dn.L` (LineA instruction) |
| Syntax | `MOVS.B <ea>,Dn`<br>`MOVS.W <ea>,Dn` |
| Description | Move the source operand to data register and sign extend to long. |
| Condition codes | see table |

### Condition codes

| X | N | Z | V | C |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| – | * | * | 0 | 0 |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–12 | `1010` |
| 1 | 11–9 | Dn |
| 1 | 8–7 | `10` |
| 1 | 6 | S |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |

- S=Size 0=byte else word.

### Example

```asm
    movs.b    d0,d1
```

```text
ea d0: .. .. .. .. .. .. .. C4
Result:
dn d1: .. .. .. .. FF FF FF C4
```

### Notes

- This is a LineA instruction, set apollo-bit in SR to become active. (ori #$800,sr)
- Do not use, only available on cores 10280 to 10904

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no MOVS. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T use MOVS: the manual says it is only available on cores 10280 to 10904.
- DO set the Apollo bit (SR bit 11, `ori #$800,sr`) before any LineA instruction.
